name: Elise Starseeker
guide_text: Hero power when it works out goldwise. For example, on turn 4 you may level to tavern 3 and hero power for 1. When your hero power costs 5, stop hero powering.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up is worth 2 gold every time to hero power, so buddy up when it costs at most 3 gold. The buddy can also be used with [[Greenskeeper]], [[Rylak Metalhead]], or [[Flotsam Flinger]] to save even more gold.
